name: Sakurairo Quartet
source:
In the near future, bioroids called Iris were created using genes from animals to be the perfect partner for humans. They now live together with humans in harmony. Ryouta is a meddlesome student at Kurama Gakuen who comes upon a stray Iris named Sakura. He decides to take her under his wing and to become her master, but then Sakura’s older sister Ui shows up, along with a suspicious guy Ogami Shingo. Even his schoolmates Ayano and Momoka get involved. It seems that she holds many secrets…

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2011/04/01/april-2011-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
在不远的未来，人类利用动物基因制造出名为“鸢尾”的生化人偶，作为人类完美的伙伴。如今，她们与人类和谐共处。爱管闲事的鞍马学园学生槙原亮太遇见一名流浪鸢尾，名叫樱。他决定收留她，成为她的主人；但樱的姐姐忧随即出现，连同可疑男子大神新吾。甚至同学绫乃与桃花也被卷入其中。樱似乎隐藏着许多秘密……

[摘自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2011/04/01/april-2011-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
